benchmark: Mimir JD Intelligence Initial Reference Benchmark
scope: JD interpretation only; no CV scoring or code change
methodology: Expert-proposed role intent, requirements, explicit constraints, alternatives, ambiguity and suggested technical/functional/operational weight distribution. Validate against hiring-manager labels before calibration.

category_definitions.technical: Engineering, systems and platform implementation or architecture
category_definitions.functional_domain: Domain expertise, business rules and specialist functional practices
category_definitions.operational_delivery: Programme execution, governance, coordination and operational delivery
category_definitions.behavioral: Do not assign arbitrary CV score for general qualities; verify or use documented work behavior in an applicable scored capability
category_definitions.eligibility: Separate verification; missing CV mention is unknown rather than failed
